hooks.command: input=$(cat); file=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); if echo "$file" | grep -qE '(^|/)\.env(\..*)?$'; then echo 'Blocked: .env* files hold secrets (GROQ_API_KEY, AUTH_SECRET, DATABASE_URL, OAuth secrets) — edit manually, not via Claude Code.' >&2; exit 2; fi
input=$(cat); file=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$file" in *.ts|*.tsx) npx eslint --fix "$file" 2>&1; npx tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json 2>&1 | head -60 ;; esac
